name: LCM TTM JVP
plain: Discards x for x0 as LCM does, re-noises to the next sigma, takes a JVP there, and applies a second-order correction before re-noising again. Two noise draws per step.
math: x←x0. x₂=x+σᵢ₊₁n. ε=(x₂−x0)/σᵢ₊₁. x0′=JVP at (x₂,σᵢ₊₁). x←e^{−h_η}x+(1−e^{−h_η})x0+(e^{−h_η}+h_η)x0′. x+=σᵢ₊₁n.
